summary: Rewrote backend_test.py to validate the REAL Baileys WhatsApp integration (Node.js sidecar on 127.0.0.1:3001 + FastAPI webhook). 40/40 pytest cases pass (100%). Covers: sidecar /health, session CRUD with 5-instance cap (6th returns 400), real connect endpoint that calls sidecar and produces a real data:image/png;base64 QR via webhook within ~10s, webhook secret enforcement (401 without/wrong X-Webhook-Secret), webhook events qr/connected/logged_out/incoming_message updating DB correctly, DELETE session cleaning /app/whatsapp-sessions/{id}, and full regression on auth/contacts/templates/campaigns/credits/AI.

minor.issue: Webhook silently returns {ok:true} when session_id is unknown. Consider logging/returning 404 for visibility when sidecar sends events for orphaned sessions (e.g., auto-restore dirs without DB row).

Auto-restore passes user_id='auto-restore' which does NOT match any DB row; if a creds.json dir exists for a deleted DB session, it will silently reconnect and emit events to a ghost user. Recommend wiping auth dirs for sessions not present in DB at sidecar boot (or query Mongo via a shared endpoint).
On sidecar 5xx we return 502 with message, but DB is left at status=desconectado. OK, but consider also clearing any stale qr_code in the same update (already None, fine).

When sidecar refuses send (status != conectado), falls back to simulation which can mark messages 'enviado' even though no real WhatsApp message was delivered. Acceptable while onboarding but should be toggled off in production (env flag).
httpx timeout=30s on /session/start is fine, but webhook to /api/whatsapp/webhook uses axios 5s timeout in Node side — if FastAPI is busy, QR event can be dropped silently.

action_items: (Recommended) Handle orphan auth dirs in /app/whatsapp-sessions on sidecar boot — compare with DB sessions or call a backend endpoint to validate before auto-restore.
(Recommended) Add env flag CAMPAIGN_SIMULATE_IF_NOT_CONNECTED=false for production so campaigns fail fast instead of simulating deliveries when session is not truly connected via Baileys.
(Nice-to-have) Increase Node axios webhook timeout to 10s to avoid dropped QR events under load.
(Nice-to-have) Split server.py (672 lines, close to 700-line threshold) into routers (auth, contacts, campaigns, whatsapp, ai).
critical_code_review_comments: Webhook secret properly validated via X-Webhook-Secret header — confirmed 401 without/with wrong secret.
MongoDB _id excluded via projection {_id:0} on every read path — verified.
Real QR code is a proper data:image/png;base64,... URL emitted by Baileys (QRCode.toDataURL), correctly persisted to DB and broadcast via WS with type=session_qr.
Session limit MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER=5 enforced at create_session; test confirmed 6th session returns 400.
DELETE /api/whatsapp/sessions/{id} correctly calls wa_client.delete which hits sidecar and removes /app/whatsapp-sessions/{id} — verified auth dir absent post-delete.
Webhook event=qr updates status to 'aguardando_qr' and persists the data URL — matches the new Literal in WhatsAppSession model.
Webhook event=logged_out clears phone_number, qr_code and sets status=desconectado — verified.
Webhook event=incoming_message updates message status to 'respondido' and increments campaign.replied counter — endpoint reachable and idempotent.
Node sidecar /health endpoint returns {ok:true, sessions:<n>} — verified alive under supervisor.
auto-restore with placeholder user_id='auto-restore' is a latent bug (see minor issues).
campaign_runner fallback to simulation when sidecar rejects send is a semantic hazard for production (mentioned in action items).
test_credentials: demo@zapflow.com / demo12345 available; tests create per-run TEST_<hex>@zapflow-qa.com users via /api/auth/register (no dependency on demo user).
seed_data_creation: Each run creates a fresh user + 1 contact + 1 template + 1 WhatsApp session + 1-2 campaigns; all cleaned up in test_zz_* teardown tests. Baileys auth_info dir /app/whatsapp-sessions/{sid} is created by sidecar during connect and removed by DELETE session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Baileys integration is fully functional. Sidecar on 127.0.0.1:3001 (supervisor program 'whatsapp'). Webhook secret: zapflow-webhook-secret (env WA_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regressions (40 tests, ~34s). Do NOT assert real WhatsApp scan — use webhook direct POSTs with X-Webhook-Secret to simulate qr/connected/logged_out/incoming_message events. Only the POST /connect test waits up to 15s for a real QR emitted by Baileys. server.py is at 672 lines, approaching split threshold.
mocked_apis_confirmed: Baileys is REAL (Node sidecar running @whiskeysockets/baileys, generating real QR)
Campaign runner falls back to SIMULATION when session not connected
rca of the issue: n/a — no regressions; only two latent risks: (1) orphan auth dirs auto-restoring with fake user_id; (2) campaign simulation fallback masking disconnected-session failures. Both documented as action items.
